name: Bilaspuri
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Bailey 1920 Linguistic Studies from the Himalayas (archive.org, read): Bilaspuri/Kahluri grammar section contains no stress or accent statement; Bailey 1908 omits Bilaspur

sources.citation: Varma, Siddheshwar (ed. T. S. Bindra). 2003. Pahari Dictionary of 27 North-Western Himalayan dialects, vol. I part II (Kangri group). Hoshiarpur: VVBIS&IS, Panjab University.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: 'Kangri group' = Hamirpuri, Sujanpuri, Jammu Dogri, Fatehpuri, Palampuri; Kahluri/Bilaspuri not included. Irrelevant.

sources.citation: Indian Institute of Advanced Study. 2002. Pahari bhasha tatha sahitya (Hindi seminar volume). Shimla: IIAS.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Kahluri only in classification lists and one specimen; svaraghat (tone/accent) is discussed for Kangri vs Panjabi only.

sources.citation: Himachal Pradesh Academy of Arts, Culture and Languages. 1990. Index to Somasi, vol. 1-16 (1975-1990). Shimla.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bibliographic only: entry (27) identifies Sharma, Jagat Pal, 'Kahluri dhvaniyan' [Kahluri sounds], Somasi 5(1), Jan 1979, p. 34 -- issue not available online (see list of works to obtain).

sources.citation: Sharma, Jagat Pal. 1982. Mandiyali ke adhikhandatmak svanim [Suprasegmental phonemes of Mandeali] (Hindi). Somasi 8(2), April 1982.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: About Mandeali, not Kahluri (word stress not phonemic, sentence stress phonemic in Mandeali); Kahluri/Bilaspuri mentioned only as a neighbouring influence. Not a Kahluri source.

sources.citation: Shandil, Shradha. 2024. Language and dialect of Himachal Pradesh. Literary Herald 10(1): 265-269.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: General dialect survey quoting Bailey; no phonology.

sources.citation: Vedamanickam, P. Edward. 2023. Bilaspuri/Kahluri. In: Language Division, Office of the Registrar General, India. Linguistic Survey of India: Himachal Pradesh, pp. 712-739. New Delhi.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Phonology sec. 2 (pp. 715-723) covers consonants, clusters, 8 vowels, vowel clusters, nasalization (not phonemic) and syllable canon; there is no suprasegmental/stress section; the only occurrence of 'stress' is a generic textbook sentence defining the syllable (p. 722).

sources.citation: Himprastha (Hindi monthly, Dept. of Information & Public Relations, Shimla), vols. 61 (2016-17), 62 (2017), 64 (2019-20), 65 (2020-21).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Vol. 61 contains suprasegmental sketches of Chambeali and Keonthali (word stress not phonemic there); Kahluri appears only in classification/history passages. No Kahluri stress statement.

sources.citation: Kashyap, Satish. 1991. Kahluri va uski svar bhasha dhvaniyan [Kahluri and its vowel speech-sounds] (Hindi). Somasi 17(4), October 1991, pp. 23-36. Shimla: Himachal Pradesh Academy of Arts, Culture and Languages.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress placement: articulatory description of each oral and nasal vowel with word-initial/medial/final examples (notes only that /ii/ and /uu/ take relatively longer articulation); no balaghat/svaraghat (stress/accent) discussion. Pages checked visually because scanned is noisy.

sources.citation: Varma, Siddheshwar. 1978. Pahari language: a linguistic analysis (G. A. Grierson's LSI, a summary). Hoshiarpur: VVRI.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Kahluri mentioned once (Handuri as a transition to 'the Kahluri Panjabi of Bilaspur'); nothing on Kahluri accent.

sources.citation: Mamgain, M. D. 1975. Himachal Pradesh District Gazetteers: Bilaspur. 'Language', pp. 70-73.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; quotes Grierson and Bailey on classification and dialect geography only.

sources.citation: Bailey, T. Grahame. 1920 [1915]. Linguistic studies from the Himalayas, being studies in the grammar of fifteen Himalayan dialects. London: Royal Asiatic Society. 'The Bilaspur and Nalagarh dialects', pp. 231-260.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing for Bilaspuri/Kahluri: the chapter is nominal/verbal paradigms and vocabulary for Bilaspuri, W./N./S. Bilaspuri, Dami and Handuri; the words accent/stress/tone do not occur in it (the preface's tone-and-accent remarks concern Panjabi, Lahnda and Kagani).

sources.citation: Grierson, G. A. 1916. Linguistic Survey of India, vol. IX part I: Western Hindi and Panjabi. Calcutta. 'Kahluri or Bilaspuri', pp. 677-678.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing: a classification note ('simply a rude Panjabi, similar to that spoken in Hoshiarpur'), speaker figures and a short interlinear specimen from Mangal State; no pronunciation section.

sources.citation: People's Linguistic Survey of India, vol. 11 part 2: The Languages of Himachal Pradesh (G. N. Devy, gen. ed.). New Delhi: Orient BlackSwan. Kahluri/Bilaspuri chapter (c. p. 130).
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: print only (no digital copy found when the work was looked up)
sources.note: PLSI chapters normally include a short phonology with a line on stress/accent; the most recent published sketch of Kahluri besides LSI-HP 2023.

sources.citation: Tobdan. 2015. Himacal Prades ki bhashaem [The languages of Himachal Pradesh] (Hindi). New Delhi: Orient Blackswan. xxxiv+336 pp.

sources.note: Glottolog's only modern reference for bila1253 (listed by Glottolog as an overview); may contain a Kahluri phonology note including balaghat.

sources.citation: Gibson, Charlotte. 1996. Sociolinguistic survey of Pahari dialects in six western districts of Himachal Pradesh: Chamba, Kangra, Hamirpur, Una, Mandi and Bilaspur districts. Pune: Deccan College (SIL survey; cited in Eaton 2008).
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Only known SIL-type fieldwork touching Bilaspuri; unlikely to state stress but may cite an unpublished phonology.

sources.citation: Sharma, Jagat Pal. 1979. Kahluri dhvaniyan [Kahluri sounds] (Hindi). Somasi 5(1), Jan 1979, p. 34ff. Shimla: Himachal Pradesh Academy of Arts, Culture and Languages.

sources.note: The one dedicated article on Kahluri sounds by a trained phonologist (the same author's 1982 Mandeali article has an explicit suprasegmental/stress section, so this one may too); identified from the Somasi index, entry 27.
